Details 
#QleverWD Most known PLANT taxons without labels
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT ?links ?taxonRank (?obj AS ?taxon) ?taxonName ?taxonParent ?categ ?categLabel ?allImages ?illustr ?diagrams ?wikipedia ?wikipediaLabel ?iNatur ?eol WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?obj ?links (SAMPLE(?taxonName0) AS ?taxonName) (SAMPLE(?taxonRank0) AS ?taxonRank) (SAMPLE(?taxonParent0) AS ?taxonParent) (SAMPLE(?eol0) AS ?eol) (SAMPLE(?iNatur0) AS ?iNatur) WHERE {
      ?obj wdt:P31 wd:Q16521 .
      ?obj wdt:P171* wd:Q756 .
      ?obj ^schema:about/wikibase:sitelinks ?links .
      
      OPTIONAL {
        ?obj wdt:P225 ?taxonName0 .
      }
      OPTIONAL {
        ?obj wdt:P105 ?taxonRank0 .
      }
      OPTIONAL {
        ?obj wdt:P171 ?taxonParent0 .
      }
      OPTIONAL {
        ?obj wdt:P830 ?eolId .
        wd:P830 wdt:P1630 ?fmt1 .
        BIND (IRI(REPLACE(?eolId, "(^.*)", ?fmt1)) AS ?eol0)
      }
      OPTIONAL {
        ?obj wdt:P3151 ?inatId .
        wd:P3151 wdt:P1630 ?fmt2 .
        BIND (IRI(REPLACE(?inatId, "(^.*)", ?fmt2)) AS ?iNatur0)
      }
    }
    GROUP BY ?obj ?links
    ORDER BY DESC(?links)
    LIMIT 3000
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj wdt:P373 ?categLabel .
    BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:", ?categLabel)) AS ?categ)
    BIND (REPLACE(STR(?obj), ".*/", "") AS ?qid)
    BIND (ENCODE_FOR_URI(CONCAT("deepcategory:\"", ?categLabel, "\"")) AS ?query)
    BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=", ?query, "&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image")) AS ?allImages)
    
	BIND (ENCODE_FOR_URI(CONCAT("deepcat:\"Botanical diagrams\" deepcategory:\"", ?categLabel, "\"")) AS ?query0)
    BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=", ?query0, "&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image")) AS ?diagrams)
    
	BIND (ENCODE_FOR_URI(CONCAT("deepcat:\"Botanical illustrations\" deepcategory:\"", ?categLabel, "\"")) AS ?query1)
    BIND (URI(CONCAT("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=", ?query1, "&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image")) AS ?illustr)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?wikipedia schema:about ?obj .
    ?wikipedia schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikipedia.org/> .
    ?wikipedia schema:name ?wikipediaLabel .
  }
}
ORDER BY DESC(?links)
